name: Microsoft Copilot for M365 (copilot.cloud.microsoft — Harmony app)

transport.status: NOT OBSERVABLE pre-auth — chat SPA and its JS bundles are only served to authenticated Entra sessions; every app path 302s to login.microsoftonline.com authorize
transport.note: M365 Copilot is expected to use SSE/WebSocket to the Turbo backend with a bundled-conversation upload flow for tenant grounding — consistent with the CSP connect-src literal but NOT verified. Consumer Copilot's verified wss://copilot.microsoft.com/c/api/chat protocol does NOT carry over; this package must re-derive the wire from an authenticated capture.

MSA blocked (blockMsaFed:true) — org tenants only.

capabilities.description: /chat/entity1-d870f6cd-4aa5-4d42-9626-ab690c041429/<base64> deep links; payload decodes to {properties:{promptSource:microsoft}, scenario:tryinappgrowth, chatType:"Work", referral:{cmmid}} — instance-scoped prompt-injection entry point.
capabilities.method: URL — VERIFIED literal (payload of landing "Get started" prompts)

capabilities.name: /webchat/* API segment
capabilities.description: M365 mounts a /webchat/* REST segment (302 authorize evidence on /webchat/api). Surface contents unobservable pre-auth.

auth.callback: form_post to /landingv2; ASP.NET Core OIDC state cookies .AspNetCore.OpenIdConnect.Nonce.* / .AspNetCore.Correlation.*; session cookies OH.SID, OH.FLID; ASLBSA/ASLBSACORS from LoginService
auth.antiBot: Microsoft Front Door/AEG WAF on turbo tier + Entra conditional access (MFA/device) expected; no Turnstile/hashcash observed on this surface
auth.note: There is NO anonymous path (unlike consumer copilot). Capture must come from a real M365 (work/school) Entra session in a headed browser; the token lives in an ASP.NET session cookie, not a JS-accessible token.

analysisMethod: static curl + redirect-chain capture + marketing-shell JS-bundle grep (~1.9MB of unauth-* bundles); full Entra authorize URL captured from live 302 location; NO browser launched, NO chat API observable pre-auth; honest hard-wall verdict
